# Platform API billing export

Nightly aggregation of billed image-pipeline usage for September 2026. The export job retried once and repeated two image-resize rows; each unique request day x team x key_type x endpoint is one line. key_type marks prod or staging keys.

turns.prompt: September's API usage export is in api-usage-2026-09.csv. What was the total cost of the image-resize endpoint for the month? Answer with the number alone, two decimals.
How much of that came from the mobile team? Answer with the number alone, two decimals.
Hold on — finance says staging traffic shouldn't be billed to product teams. Recompute the image-resize total with the staging keys left out. Answer with the number alone, two decimals.
